text: さわった　あいてを　まひさせる

structure.jp: さわった　あいてを

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. さわった　あいて = 'the opponent that touched it'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる says you make someone do or undergo something. まひさせる = 'makes it become paralyzed'.
